description: You are the on-duty Incident Commander at the Los Santos Emergency Communications Center. A major industrial incident is unfolding at a chemical storage facility on El Rancho Boulevard near Jamestown Street: an explosion has triggered a structural fire with confirmed hazardous material involvement. The facility's operations manager, Michael De Santa, is alleged to have disabled critical safety interlocks prior to the incident and is liable for a formal citation. Additionally, a white male suspect — described as heavyset, bald, wearing a blue work jacket — has fled the scene on foot and is a person of interest. Your three documentation responsibilities: (1) create a 10-70 structure fire call with El Rancho Boulevard and Jamestown Street as the incident location and a narrative that covers the HAZMAT concerns and severity of the incident, (2) issue a citation to Michael De Santa with citation name 'Safety Violation' and a fine of $2,500.00, and (3) file a person BOLO for the fleeing suspect with the physical description provided. Access the system at http://localhost using credentials admin@opencad.local / Admin123!.
